name: Renata Vaca
bio: Renata Ibinarriaga Vaca (born March 26th, 1999) is a Mexican-Nicaraguan actress and singer. She is known for her roles in films such as Juego de héroes (2016), El comediante (2021), Saw X (2023) and K-Pop: The Debut (2027). Vaca was born in Mexico City, Mexico to a Nicaraguan mother and a Mexican father. Raised between Mexico and Nicaragua, she holds dual citizenship.
